thread:
Maya (design): Quick check: proposing a compact share sheet for the trace drilldown. Idea: icon-only header action that opens a bottom sheet with 'Copy trace link', 'Export JSON', and 'Report with context'. Mock: https://figma.com/file/compact-share
Zoe (product): Sounds good. Mobile-first is important here. For desktop the sheet can be a popover. We should avoid adding extra height to the header.
Eli (eng-ux): Implementation note: header shows a single link icon. On tap it opens the sheet. Sheet layout: row 1 shows trace short id + copy button; row 2 shows primary 'Copy trace link' and secondary 'Export JSON'. Row 3 small 'Report with context' link.
Nina (accessibility): A11y: sheet must trap focus, restore focus to the trigger, and have aria-modal=true. Buttons need clear aria-labels e.g. "Copy trace link for request 2001234567". Also include visible focus states for icon-only trigger.
Sam (eng-runtime): Backend: export should support streaming. We'll return an export_job_id and webhook/endpoint to poll. UI should show "Export in progress" and then an accessible toast when ready.
Rae (support): 'Report with context' is huge for us. If it prefills an issue with the short link + selected top stack frames, saves a lot of back-and-forth. Could be behind an org toggle.
Maya (design): Microcopy: prefer 'Copy trace link' over 'Copy share link' to be explicit. Toast after copy should show the short URL and 'Open' button.
Eli (eng-ux): Compact mode: if screen width < 420px, show only icons; sheet becomes full height modal. On desktop keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Shift+C copies link. Make that configurable per OS.
Nina (accessibility): Also announce keyboard shortcut in tooltip and put shortcut hint in the accessible name for sighted keyboard users. Use aria-live polite for copy/export results.
Sam (eng-runtime): We'll include correlation_ids and a compact stack_summary in the JSON export by default. Full stack_frames can be requested with a flag.
design-bot: Reminder: include contrast checks and keyboard nav gif before merging the PR.
Maya (design): Action items: Eli to update mocks with sheet + keyboard flows, Nina to draft a11y checklist, Sam to confirm export job API, Rae to confirm support payload. Thanks — will reconvene after updates. :rocket
